title: Stuttgart-based Sereact, which develops software for industrial robots to handle tasks they haven't been trained on, raised a $110M Series B led by Headline (Yazhou Sun/Bloomberg)
summary: Yazhou Sun / Bloomberg: Stuttgart-based Sereact, which develops software for industrial robots to handle tasks they haven't been trained on, raised a $110M Series B led by Headline — Sereact, a German robotics software company, has raised $110 million in fresh funding to develop its artificial intelligence model …
